history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-19: after floor3's study on 38858846, the owner asked to file the suggested runs, floor3 on current main among them. Pilot first (RULES 16), then small, medium, big and full, each after the previous gate (RULES 14).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-19, before any result of these profiles was read. Pilot (RULES 16).
floor3 on 38858846 (classes-1800, all 1,800 starts, 100,000 turns): 103 against ctl's 100 deaths, mean max CL +0.37,
DL +0.13; 200,000 turns, starts 19-90: CL +0.64. Main has since changed the town scares (caution_town_scary_levels_less
3, which takes floor3's town monsters at 3-3 to no scare in town), the damage rule (50) and the rising ticks (500).
Gate:
- no config_error; one binary; each arm's lines in its borg.txt and scary list (floor3's written list differs from
  ctl's only in the scare ranges; the ignore entries are the same);
- every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn bursts classified and key outliers listed;
- death bundles reproduced;
- ctl writes nothing, so it should replay reborn-errands-main-pilot's none arm (the same specimen and starts) in 18
  of 18 games.
Read per class: identical plays against ctl; deaths and causes (by monster, and CL at death), CL1-4 deaths, final
level, deepest level; paired rescued and newly killed. Each value is reported as harmful, neutral (safe to adopt)
or helpful (RULES 18). Direction only.
experiment.question: On borg-reborn-rs main 3ba17e2c, does the scary list cut by 5 with a floor at CL 3 (floor3) keep its progress gain over the shipped list without more deaths?
